content: net10.0 crypto availability: System.Security.Cryptography.X25519 doc 404s and .NET 10 whats-new lists only AES KeyWrap-with-Pad and post-quantum additions - X25519/Ed25519 NOT in-box, need NSec 26.4.0 (MIT, libsodium). ChaCha20Poly1305 Class and HKDF Class docs exist in System.Security.Cryptography for net10.0 - both in-box. AES-CBC, HMAC-SHA2, SHA-2, RandomNumberGenerator in-box. Sources Microsoft Learn pages + .NET 10 overview. Confidence HIGH for in-box items, MEDIUM-HIGH for X25519 absence.
